Read about the data from the website where it is staged.  

Form three regression models; 
  Model1 is mpg~disp, 
  Model2 is mpg~hp, and 
  Model3 is mpg~disp+hp. 
  
For each model find a 95% prediction interval of MPG given a value of 183 for disp and 250 for hp.

After all three models have been constructed, compare Model1 with Model3 using anova. Document the comparison the markdown document, 

As usual, push the project up to your github account and submit the URL to canvas as link. 

 


```{r include=FALSE}
require(tidyverse)
require(tigerstats)
require(rgl)
require(knitr)
library(MASS)

```

```{r}
data(mtcars)
myData=mtcars

```

## Model 1 mpg ~ disp

### scatterplot
```{r}
plot(mpg~disp,data=mtcars,pch=15)
```

The above scatterplot shows that as the disp increases, the mpg decreases.

### Numerical results
```{r}
cor(mpg~disp,data=mtcars)
```


### Inferential  (Build model.1)
```{r}
model.1 <- lm(mpg~disp,data=mtcars)
summary.lm(model.1)
```
For every 1 inch in disp, mpg goes down by 0.04.
The P value is 

#### Predict at target point
```{r}
newdata=data.frame(disp=183,hp=250)
predict(model.1,newdata)
```


#### scatterplot with model fit
